# Is 100% saved lives completely impossible?

Steam discussion in *Robin Hood*, opened by Karczek 26⁵⁰ zł/kg on 5 April 2021.

## Discussion

**Karczek 26⁵⁰ zł/kg — 5 April 2021:**

> Is this a bug or is 100% saved lives completely impossible?
>
> So I just completed saving Little John mission and my saved lives stat shows 98%
> Why? Do bodies that already were on the map count into dead too? Is this a bug? It should be possible to get 100%

**[λ] MatGreen [GΞR] — 11 April 2021:**

> It's been a while since I last played the game, but did you maybe kill a knight? You can't tie them up afaik, and I think there might have been one in that level.

**Karczek 26⁵⁰ zł/kg — 11 April 2021:**

> No, killed nobody, just snuck behind him, freed John without anybody raising the alarm, and that's all, replayed the mission several times just to confirm, the scenery bodies count as non-saved lives

**Saxton — 18 April 2021:**

> It may be a bug, but if so it's a bug that's been there since the original release - the already dead enemies count against you! There's a mission later on where you will have allies who kill the opponents, and it also counts against YOUR "no one killed" score - so don't even bother trying, unfortunately!

**Karczek 26⁵⁰ zł/kg — 19 April 2021:**

> Yeah, already finished the game, managed to get 97%, I wonder if I could bump it up but don't want to bother
> Time for a 0% attempt :>

**Grafenschreck — 22 February, year not shown:**

> A little late but: The mission where you save Little J f*cks up your statistic. The mission starts with civilians already being dead and those count as lost lives unfortunately.

**Nobutora — 15 March, year not shown:**

> in that mission there are already dead civies and soldiers, that counts as saved lives, so its impossible to get 100% unless you use Spellforge editor to make them alive at the start of the mission
